title: 1637 Prairie gets its garden wall, iron fence and railed stoop
items: The Spalding house at 1637 Prairie now has the front garden its engraving draws: a tall brick wall before the north side, ending in a pier before the curved bay, and a tall iron spear fence before the south wing.
Both stand on a line about 3.5 m in front of the house, where the engraving's ground puts them, rather than out on the street line.
The front steps now have turned balustrades along both sides, level beside the landing and running down the flight.
